blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — All 311 passengers aboard a fast craft were rescued safely after an engine fire broke out while the vessel was sailing off the coast of Cebu on Sunday, November 22, with overheating cited as the cause of the incident, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said. The vessel was bound for Ormoc City, Leyte, from Cebu City when the fire started in its starboard engine at around 10:21 a.m. It was extinguished a minute later, at approximately 10:22 a.m., according to Coast Guard Station Central Cebu.
